name: hello-justifiable
description: Two steps: one produces an artifact under a declared path, one proves the artifact says what it claims.

steps.label: produce
steps.prompt: mkdir -p examples/.work && printf 'status: ok\nreviewed: yes\n' > examples/.work/hello.md && echo PRODUCE_COMPLETE

grep_present.description: hello.md must record the status the produce step claimed to write
